eval-bot: Nightly eval run complete for model redwood-3b-int8-v4 (2026-03-19 02:10 UTC)
Summary: overall macro metrics stable, but 'answer_omission' on long-context QA increased from 1.2% -> 5.9% (regression detected)
Run: https://evals.internal/runs/1952468100

anya.k: noticed this in the dashboard at 02:14. Posting two representative failures (shortened):

anya.k: >>> PROMPT 1 (customer-qa-longcontext):
"""
Context: <~2500 tokens of user docs...>
Q: What is the recommended retry backoff for transient DB errors?
"""
Model output: """


"""
(expected: a paragraph with backoff values and config)

chris.t: +1 saw that sample. Does this line up with any infra change last night?

ritesh: We merged int8-kv-optimizations (kernel v4) in the inference runtime yesterday at 23:20 UTC. Commit: https://git.internal/r/infra/commit/8f7b2c4
I also pushed a quant build that enabled packed-kv by default for int8 variants.

maria.p: Could this be a KV-cache prefix truncation? If the model stops seeing the question because of eviction, it might produce empty/garbled output.

ritesh: Reproduced locally: when sequence length > 2048 and packed-kv enabled, I can trigger early EOS in ~10-15% of runs for the long-ctx QA prompts. Behavior matches omission.

anya.k: Can you paste repro command?

ritesh: Repro (local docker, small snippet):
```
python -m redwood_infer.cli --model redwood-3b-int8-v4 \
  --input-file tests/long_qa/prompts.jsonl \
  --max-tokens 512 --packed-kv true --seed 42
```
Look for outputs that are just newline or truncated sentence. I ran 200 seeds; omission rate ~6%.

chris.t: That aligns with nightly numbers. Any idea which change in the kernel caused it?

ritesh: Root cause narrow-down: packed-kv packing logic assumes int8 quantization preserves sentinel token scores' relative order; with a new fused-attn kernel the low-precision accumulation causes sentinel token logits to underflow and sometimes push EOS over threshold. Essentially EOS gets triggered/decoded at wrong timestep when KV layout crosses a cache-block boundary.

maria.p: Good find. So not a tokenizer issue or promptset drift. It's numeric/packing + fused kernel interaction.

anya.k: Impact: only int8-packed variant and only long contexts (>~2k) show spike. Hosted float32 + int8-unpacked are fine. That limits blast radius to customers on int8-packed serving.

chris.t: Mitigation suggestions? Immediate / short term?

ritesh: Short-term: rollback the packed-kv default for int8 on serving and redeploy int8 v3 kernels. That will revert to previous behavior (we can do a fast patch rollback). Also create a 5% canary with the old kernel to ensure stability.

maria.p: Add gating: nightly eval should gate any model variant when omission delta > 1% absolute on long-ctx QA. We should also fail-promote any quantized build that increases omission above that.

anya.k: Agreed. Also add a synthetic unit test that exercises EOS detection with packed-kv + int8 under various seeds and lengths. Run it in CI at quant-build time.

infra-bot: Suggested canary rollout config:
```
canary: {
  "model": "redwood-3b-int8-v4",
  "fallback": "redwood-3b-int8-v3",
  "traffic_split": {"v3": 95, "v4": 5},
  "region": "us-west1",
  "timeout_minutes": 60
}
```

ritesh: Action plan (short):
- [P0] rollback packed-kv default for int8 on serving (ritesh) - ETA 2 hours
- [P0] deploy canary 5% with v3 fallback (infra) - ETA 1 hour after rollback
- [P1] add nightly gating rule (anya) - ETA EOD
- [P1] add CI synthetic EOS/unit tests (ritesh + maria) - ETA 2 days
- [P2] deeper numeric investigation + kernel fix upstream (chris + runtime team) - ETA 1 week

chris.t: I'll own the kernel PR once we have a repro test. Can someone add a minimal reproducer as a unit test in runtime repo?

ritesh: I'll open PR with reproducer and the quick rollback change. PR link (placeholder): https://git.internal/r/infra/pull/3291

anya.k: I'll update the nightly eval config to add the 1% gating and rerun the flagged runs from the last 7 days to check customer impact. If >0.5% active customers are affected we'll escalate to incident.

maria.p: For postmortem notes: note that a combined change (packed-kv + fused-attn-int8) created a new numerical corner. We should add a matrix test across packed/unpacked x kernel variants x seq-len in our quant harness.

chris.t: +1 on matrix tests. Also add a perf note: disabling packed-kv may increase token-cost by ~6-8% for long-context, log that to rollout notes.

anya.k: OK putting this into the release rollback tracker now. Anyone object to immediate rollback?

ritesh: No objections. Starting rollback now. Will post updates.

infra-bot: Deploy job started: job_id=deploy-7782; rolling back int8-packed default on prod cluster-3.

anya.k: Thanks everyone — keep thread updated. I'll follow up with gating PR and sample metrics after rerun. :white_check_mark:
